sentences.en: I walk to school every day.
He runs fast in the park.
We sit on the chairs.
They stand up when the teacher comes.
sentences.zh: 老师进来时他们站起来。

sentences.en: The cat jumps onto the table.
Turn left at the corner.
Push the door to open it.
Pull the rope.
I lift the box with my hands.
The apple falls from the tree.
Open the window, please.
Shut the door after you.
Do not run in the house.
She turns her head and smiles.
I moved the chair to the corner.
She lost her balance and almost fell.
I have a strong grip on the rope.
Stop at the red light.
Twist the top of the bottle to open it.
I move my hand to say goodbye.
Do not cry.
Everything is all right.
Fold the paper in half.
The flame of the candle was bright.
I have a general idea of the story.
sentences.zh: 我对这个故事有一个大致的了解。

sentences.en: The roof is hanging over the edge.
I fall down and hurt my knee.
A driver uses a brake to stop the car.
